class.name: CgameUtilityAI
class.brief_description: Utility AI response curves, IAUS score combination and infected prey scoring.
class.description: Native port of the Cgame GDScript Utility AI helpers (Dave Mark's Infinite Axis Utility System). Each option is scored by multiplying normalised considerations shaped by response curves, with a compensation factor so options with many considerations are not unfairly punished. All methods are static and deterministic. [method infected_target_score] additionally scores infected prey choice: proximity dominates, but a wounded straggler, the survivor already being chased and a noisy survivor each tip the balance.

method.name: best
method.description: Returns the index of the best scoring option. Ties keep the earliest index; returns [code]-1[/code] when no option scores above zero.

method.name: combine
method.description: Multiplies the (clamped to [code][0, 1][/code]) considerations and applies the IAUS compensation factor. Returns [code]0.0[/code] for an empty array or when any consideration is zero (veto).

method.name: curve
method.description: Evaluates a response curve. [param x] is clamped to [code][0, 1][/code] first and the result is clamped to the same range. [param slope] and [param shift] reshape the curve ([constant LINEAR]: [code]x * slope + shift[/code]; [constant LOGISTIC]: steepness and horizontal offset; [constant STEP]: threshold offset from [code]0.5[/code]).

method.name: infected_target_score
method.description: Scores a prey candidate for an infected. Returns [code]0.0[/code] for non-finite distances or a non-positive [param leash]. Beyond the leash a new target scores [code]0.0[/code] while the current focus keeps [code]0.01[/code] so it is never dropped by scoring. Within the leash the score is an inverse-quadratic proximity term (floored at [code]0.02[/code]) multiplied by bonuses for wounded prey (up to +35%), the current target (+25%) and noisy prey (+15%).

constants.constant: S-curve centred at [code]0.5 + shift[/code] with steepness [code]10 * slope[/code].
